ns2:course.label: Mechanical Design II
ns2:course.description: Design and analysis of machinery for load-bearing and power transmission. Consideration of material failure modes, including yielding, fracture, fatigue, and creep. Design and selection of machine elements: bolts, springs, rolling-element bearings, fluid-film lubrication, and power transmissions, including gears and friction drives. Prerequisite: ME 330 and ME 370.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Mechanical Engineering major(s). Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
